latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the find-skills skill.

- Helps users discover and install agent skills based on their needs or queries.
- Guides users to search for skills using the Skills CLI and provides relevant commands and examples.
- Offers suggestions for various common categories and how to phrase searches effectively.
- Explains how to present and install found skills.
- Provides guidance for cases when no relevant skill is found, including how to create new skills.
